title: Add CI, scheduled refresh, Pages deployment, and operations documentation
objective: Complete the repository delivery path with least-privilege CI, a six-hour last-known-good data refresh, GitHub Pages deployment, and exact Chinese developer/operations documentation.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Python, schema, data, frontend, scripts, tests, dependencies, accepted design, or other task artifacts.
Do not reference credentials, cookies, paid APIs, Playwright profiles, or Xiaohongshu in unattended public collection.
Do not grant workflow permissions beyond each job's minimum need, use pull_request_target, execute untrusted fork code with a write token, or persist collection.json/raw posts.
Do not merge, push the default branch, enable Pages, or deploy from the worker task.
deliverables: .github/workflows/ci.yml for Python 3.11 tests, compile, site build/smoke, JavaScript syntax, dependency check, and workflow YAML parsing with contents:read
.github/workflows/refresh-data.yml for six-hour/manual Guba-only refresh using the data branch as single-writer LKG storage, concurrency protection, and contents:write only
.github/workflows/deploy.yml for fixed-ref master code plus data-branch state, gated site build, and Pages deployment with contents:read/pages:write/id-token:write
Chinese README with public URL, truthful source table, methodology, exact setup/run/test commands, repository architecture, limitations, and no investment-advice disclaimer
docs/OPERATIONS.md covering initial data-branch/Pages setup, manual refresh/deploy, workflow observability, degraded behavior, troubleshooting, rollback, security, and cadence
Atomic implementation commit and handoff report
acceptance_criteria: CI runs on pull requests and default-branch pushes without write permissions and executes all local quality gates.

Refresh runs at most every six hours plus manual dispatch, collects only Guba by default, reuses data-branch LKG history, validates/builds/checks before committing only public history/dashboard JSON, and never commits collection.json.
A collection failure can still publish a schema-valid degraded payload while preserving the last successful index history.
Deploy checks out default-branch code and data-branch payload deterministically, gates the artifact, uses official Pages actions, and deploys only after an allowed trusted event.
All workflows parse as YAML, use pinned major action versions and explicit least-privilege permissions/concurrency, and contain no secrets or account-specific tokens.
README and operations docs accurately match executable commands and clearly distinguish Guba live from Xiaohongshu unavailable/local-only behavior.
Changes remain inside the declared protected write scope and are delivered as an atomic commit.
